_about: Bernard William Henderson (1872-1929), Exeter College Oxford, raw IA OCR of his Life and Principate of the Emperor Nero (1903; issue of 1905), Civil War and Rebellion in the Roman Empire A.D. 69-70 (1908), The Study of Roman History (1921) and The Life and Principate of the Emperor Hadrian (1923). Roman history (lane B, round eb: eighth IA subject sweep). No uids minted. Round ec adds The Great War between Athens and Sparta (preface 1926) and Five Roman Emperors (preface June 1927).

bernard-w-henderson-nero: The Life and Principate of the Emperor Nero, by Bernard W. Henderson, new and cheaper issue (London: Methuen & Co.; first published 1903, this issue 1905)
bernard-w-henderson-civil-war-rebellion-: Civil War and Rebellion in the Roman Empire A.D. 69-70, a companion to the 'Histories' of Tacitus, by Bernard W. Henderson (London: Macmillan and Co., 1908)
bernard-w-henderson-study-of-roman-histo: The Study of Roman History, by Bernard W. Henderson (Duckworth's Student Series II; London: Duckworth; first issued 1920, new edition 1921)
bernard-w-henderson-hadrian-1923: The Life and Principate of the Emperor Hadrian A.D. 76-138, by Bernard W. Henderson (New York: Brentano's; no year on the title page, the preface is dated April 1923)
bernard-w-henderson-great-war-athens-spa: The Great War between Athens and Sparta, a companion to the military history of Thucydides, by Bernard W. Henderson (London: Macmillan and Co.; no year on the title page, the preface is dated July 17, 1926)
bernard-w-henderson-five-roman-emperors: Five Roman Emperors: Vespasian, Titus, Domitian, Nerva, Trajan, A.D. 69-117, by Bernard W. Henderson (Cambridge: at the University Press; no year on the title page, the preface is dated June 1927)
